Mature sizeable balanced powerful muscular Saint Bernard, body slightly longer than tall rather than exaggerated massive puppy build. Strong broad gently rounded head with clear stop, medium even-width muzzle, firm modest flews not excessive drooping, broad black nose and medium darkbrown eyes with restrained natural lids. Medium high-set wide rounded triangular natural drop ears, strong neck with only moderate loose skin, broad firm level back, deep chest not below elbow, modest abdominal tuck. Four strong coherent limb courses with moderate hind angulation and large compact arched paws. Long-haired variety: straight medium-length topcoat with thick undercoat, short face/ear hair, slight haunch/croup waviness, feathered front legs and well-furnished thigh breeches. White base with fresh clear-red mantle/patch distribution and dark mask; white chest, feet, muzzle band, blaze, neck patch and tail tip. Full attached long heavy bushy natural tail reaching at least the hock, hanging downward with only a slight upturn of its lower third; never curled over the back.

profileEvidence.summary: Friendly and watchful in the breed standard, the long-haired Saint Bernard shares the calm-to-lively character of its short-coated counterpart. Swiss hospice dogs guarded the Great St Bernard Pass and helped travelers lost in snow and fog. The modern breed developed from regional farm dogs; coat length distinguishes this variety.
profileEvidence.shortDescription: A friendly, watchful Swiss companion in the standard, with a shared hospice rescue history and a longer coat.

profileEvidence.summary: Lively, alert and keen to work in its breed standard, the Mudi is a Hungarian herder used with large and difficult livestock. The same standard describes courage, watchfulness and adaptability, and records work in wild-boar drives. Blue-merle denotes a coat pattern; these working tendencies belong to the breed rather than its color.
profileEvidence.shortDescription: A lively, alert Hungarian herder in the standard; blue-merle is a coat pattern, with the same working character.
profileEvidence.author: L worker B
